addRelative.q: How do I add a relative?
addRelative.a: From “My family”, a parent picks “Add a relative” then sends an invitation by e-mail or gives a code valid for 48 hours.

fiveMessages.a: So that every message counts. An adult can leave up to 5 for the same child. Remove one to add another.

recordVoice.q: How do I record my voice?
recordVoice.a: Open a story to record, then tap “Record” on your character’s line. You can listen again and start over as often as you like.

forgotCode.a: A parent can reset the code of a child or a relative from “My family”. For a parent’s code, use the e-mail sign-in.

favoriteVoice.q: How do I keep a favourite voice?
favoriteVoice.a: While listening, the child taps the heart. The message goes to their vault, which keeps up to 10 keepsakes.

otherLanguage.q: Can we read in another language?
otherLanguage.a: Yes: a story can have one text per family language. The child reads in the language chosen in their profile.
